summary: The agent read the requirements and design, then submitted two design proposals for phase P3: a `TaskPresenter` with an `isOverdue(task, todayLocal)` rule covering REQ-010 AC3–AC6, and a `renderTask` method covering REQ-002 AC3, plus re-render messages added to SEQ-003. All tool calls succeeded, so there are no failures to chase. Review the proposals against the requirements, paying particular attention to whether `todayLocal` is the right way to handle timezones in the overdue rule, and confirm that SEQ-003 still matches the updated design.

steps: P1: Remove 'Due dates' from the out-of-scope list (keep priorities and categories out of scope).

P1: Add a new requirement 'Task due date': a task may have an optional calendar due date (date only, no time), set when adding and set, changed or cleared when editing; an invalid date is rejected; the due date is stored on the server and kept after reopening.

P1: Add a new requirement 'Due date display and overdue': the list shows the due date next to a task that has one; an open task whose due date is before today (user's local date) is visibly marked overdue; a done task or a task without a due date is never marked overdue; list order of REQ-007 stays unchanged.
P1: Update REQ-001 and REQ-005 texts and criteria to mention the optional due date on add and edit.
P2: Add optional attribute dueDate (ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD or null) to Task DSN-005.
P2: Extend TaskController DSN-006 create body with dueDate and update body with dueDate (null clears it).
P2: Extend TaskService DSN-007 add and add a setDueDate (or edit) operation with date validation; update SEQ-002 and SEQ-004 accordingly.
P2: Extend TaskStore DSN-008 to persist dueDate (new nullable column with migration of existing databases).
P2: Update UC-001, UC-002, UC-004 descriptions and Browser page DSN-003 for due date input, display and overdue marking; link the new requirements.
P3: Add tests for the new requirements' acceptance criteria and adjust UC-001, UC-002, UC-004 tests.
P4: Implement dueDate in Task, TaskStore (column and migration), TaskService validation, TaskController and app routes, and the date input, display and overdue marker in public/index.html.
P5: Run all tests and check that existing tasks without due date still load and behave as before.
